name: Dryzek
description: A legendary eight-hundred-year-old giant berserker newly returned from Udzec who pledges loyalty to Ruric and Thar and encourages Arrus to find his own Rage.

timeline.summary: At the ruined battlefront the Ghor Clan builds rubble tributes and Rage spreads through the crowd, but Arrus can only pretend to feel it.
timeline.quote: And just like that, Rage ignites.

timeline.summary: Arrus tattoos Jiri and learns Dryzek may challenge Ruric and Thar for chieftain.
timeline.quote: I think he's going to challenge Ruric and Thar for clan chieftain,

timeline.summary: Dryzek tells Arrus that Rage speaks differently to different people, hinting he knows Arrus's heart is cold, and Arrus starts tattooing his arm.
timeline.quote: I know Rage when I see it, and that ain't it. But it'll find you.

timeline.summary: Dryzek kneels and offers a roasted drake to Ruric and Thar as a token of loyalty, sealing a blood kinship instead of a coup.
timeline.quote: The deal is sealed with a blood kinship, and all the walls between factions come crashing down.

timeline.summary: The ink Arrus made bursts into flame on Jiri, Dryzek and other warriors, and Ruric and Thar cast Arrus out of the clan.
timeline.quote: Your services are no longer needed here,

timeline.summary: Arrus finally finds his Rage, rooted in anger at his people's lost stories, and rises from the beating.
timeline.quote: There's no more pain, only Rage.

timeline.summary: Arrus tells the clan that Selesnya is draining the Rubblebelt, and Jiri, Baas, Dryzek and others join him in flames.
timeline.quote: He stands behind me, and my flames all but leap for him.

relations.note: He pledges loyalty to them as chieftains.
relations.quote: A token, my chieftain, of my loyalty to Ghor Clan.

pages_say.description: A legendary eight-hundred-year-old giant berserker newly returned from Udzec who pledges loyalty to Ruric and Thar and encourages Arrus to find his own Rage.
